featured_reviews.name: S D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrid story to tell about theobroma i c colony giving us a HALF BAKED WET CHEESECAKE!!

So it was my mothers 68th birthday yesterday 30 Nov 2024. I ordered her a surprise cake from the theobroma store thats just 300m from home. We didnt check it as it was a surprise for my mother.

In the evening we opened the cake from the fridge & saw that the CHEESECAKE WAS RUNNY AND LIQUID!!! The letters on the cake were moving, attached pic above.The plastic around couldnt be removed as the cake would overflow!! The baker honestly didnt bake it right. WE SANG HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUT MUMMY DIDNT CUT THE CAKE!!! SEE PHOTO.

What a disappointment to see my mother unable to cut the cake as it was liquid. She was sad, we felt so bad to see her unable to cut the liquid cake. Our guests left without eating cake as well. We were embarrased in front of guests and friends, giving mummy a bad unbaked cake. We went out to dinner anyway & put the cake in fridge to try it out today 1Dec, thinking maybe it needed to set properly. Complaining at 10pm was not a priority as we didnt want to ruin the evening further for mummy.

Today morning 1 Dec we checked it again at 11am, its still sticky, and not set. Its like icecream and stickier. Finally i took pictures today 1 Dec at 12pm after removing the plastic & it fell apart!! I called theobroma to address the issue. After forwarding them pics on whatsapp, i get the response "Thank you for the feedback. We cannot help you as its 24 hours passed"

They expected us to call them in front of our guests last night at 10pm to complain 🤦‍♀️ Very disappointed to say the least. The evening was ruined as mom stood to cut cake & there was no cake as it was liquid. It hadnt set.The baker didnt bake it correctly.

Im a regular customer & yet they didnt have the courtesy to offer to repair the damage done especially given the occasion of a birthday of a senior. Or even return the money. The cake is as it is, see below pic. Its shape changed because it overflowed.

Never will i return back or recommend. Thanks for ruining a birthday. Here i am on my day off, complaining, only to be unheard. Where are your ethics when you managed to ruin a birthday,& yet show no courtesy to customer grievances?

The cake is still at home, uneaten and uncut. What a horrible birthday we had because of theobroma i c colony staff. She will never forget this bad experience.

featured_reviews.name: BhataktiAatmaWasHere
featured_reviews.review_text:
Faredoon is a Persian name meaning pure, blessed, lucky, fortunate — which already feels like a promise before you even take a bite.

Tucked inside El Plaza at I.C. Colony (a residential building that has quietly turned into a full-time food court), Faredoon's is easy to miss if you blink. the interiors are bright, inviting and aesthetically done.

I sampled the Salli Chicken Bun, Chicken Kheema Pav Bun, the Non-Veg Trio Croissant, a Brownie Pound slice cake, and a Caramel Cream Puff. And honestly? Not a single misstep. The breads are pillowy-soft, the fillings generous (borderline indulgent), and the flavours… dangerously addictive. The kind that make you question why you didn’t order one more for later.

A special shoutout to Pratik for the prompt, warm service — the kind that makes the experience feel effortless and welcoming.
It’s also easy on the pocket, which in today’s economy deserves a separate round of applause.

So yes, Faredoon's lives up to its name. I walked in curious, walked out blessed, and returned home feeling incredibly lucky. Fortune, in this case, clearly favours the hungry. 🍀

featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unnati Bakery in Dahisar West has been a part of my life for more than 20 years. This is one of those bakeries I grew up with, and even today, it is where my family and I go for our favourites. For us, it is always the Kesar Pista Nankhatai, Jam Nankhatai, Wine Biscuits, and their fresh paav. These are something we still enjoy with the same excitement as we did years ago.

What I love is that the taste and quality have not changed. Their nankhatai is always fresh and soft, and the aroma of baked goods hits you as soon as you enter the bakery. The staff is polite and quick to pack everything up, so even if you stop by on a busy day, you don’t have to wait long.

There is no seating here, so it is only for takeaway, but that has always worked for us. This bakery continues to be one of those familiar neighbourhood stops I can rely on every single time.

Service - 4/5
